Questions

What does it cost?

Nothing for founding writers: you get QueryHawk Pro free for your entire querying campaign.

Do I need a finished manuscript?

No. If you're still writing or revising, there's a set-up for that too, ready for when you start querying.

I already track my queries in a spreadsheet.

Bring it with you. Smart Import reads your spreadsheet and sets everything up, or you can start fresh in minutes.

What do you ask of founding writers?

Occasional feedback to help shape QueryHawk. That's it.

Links to other pages removed

  • Top bar: the menu has gone, so it's just the logo and Join, which scrolls to the sign-up.
  • "Read our story →" under the principles has gone.
  • Footer: the Product, Company and Log in links have gone, leaving the logo, the one line and "© 2026 QueryHawk · Privacy".
  • Kept on purpose: the Privacy link, here and beside the founding card's sign-up. The page collects email addresses, and UK data rules need you to point people to how you'll use them. Terms isn't needed for a waiting list, so it's gone.

What I fixed while checking

  • The join bar came back over the footer. After you passed the founding card, the bar reappeared on top of the footer. It now stays away once you've reached the founding card, which has the same sign-up just above.
  • The Birds-eye loop ran forever. The accessibility rule is that anything that moves for more than five seconds needs a way to stop. It now plays its story twice and rests, and holds still for anyone with reduced motion turned on.

Still open

  • Desktop hasn't been touched. All of this is the phone page. The desktop landing page still has the animated story card in its hero and the old feature rows. Do you want the Birds-eye window and the pointing-hawk card on desktop too, or should desktop stay as it is?
  • The pointing hawk is my cut-out. It's clean now, but your artist's own file of him on his own would be sharper and safer to build from.
  • The card is small in A. At this size the story reads, but the chips and dates on the card are too small to make out. That's the trade-off for A's tilt and the hawk.
  • Words I wrote that need checking: the Birds-eye feature's line and ticks, its dates and chips (apart from "Send the full" and "Worth a nudge"), and the four FAQ answers. The "still writing" answer assumes that set-up path exists by launch.
  • Page length. It's about 6,100px on a phone, much like today, because of the five big picture panels. It doesn't feel long, since nothing stops you scrolling. All six features are now full size.
  • Sample numbers. "37 of 50 places left" stands in for the live count. If the count can't load, the bars hide, as they do now.

What the build retires

The phone hero sheet with the animated card, the page snapping, the sticky-picture feature story, the vision carousel and the founding strip above the top bar. The founding sign-up itself, its store and the join bar's behaviour stay as they are.
